references.title: Overtime on a normal working day at not less than 1.5 × the hourly rate (EA s.60A(3)(a)); at most 104 hours in a month (Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg.2). Rest-day and public-holiday overtime are their own lines. EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded). Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 7): EA First Schedule paras 1A–2 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): these premia bind an employee earning not more than RM4,000 a month (s.2 wages less commission, subsistence and overtime: terms.monthly_wage) or engaged in manual labour, supervising it, operating or maintaining a commercial vehicle, or as vessel crew, whatever the pay; not a domestic employee (para 2(5)); terms.overtime_by_contract applies them by contract. EA s.60I (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay is monthly ÷ 26 (s.60I(1A)), weekly ÷ 6 (s.60I(1B)), and for a daily, hourly or piece rate the preceding wage period's wages ÷ the days worked (s.60I(1C), the days of a piece or hourly worker read from the period's WORK-day hours ÷ the normal hours); the hourly rate is it ÷ the contract's normal hours a day (s.60I(1)(b), s.60A(3)(c); terms.normal_hours_per_day, else company.normal_daily_hours, else 8). Pay basis: terms.pay_basis. Part-time terms (Part-Time Employees Regulations 2010 regs 2, 4, 5, 6(6), 9(3), https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/10.%20Employment%20-%20Part-time%20Employees%20-%20Regulations%202010%20%20%281%29.pdf): the hours beyond the part-timer's normal hours up to a full-timer's day (company.normal_daily_hours, 8 by reg.4(1)) at 1.0× and beyond it at 1.5× the hourly rate. Fixed contractual cash allowances enter the ordinary monthly or weekly wage; travel or special-expense reimbursements belong in claims. Meal allowances receive no holiday uplift (EA s.60D(3)(b)).

description: Normal working-day overtime hours, paid at the statutory multiplier.

references.title: Work on a rest day by a monthly-rated employee within the normal hours: half a day's wages for up to half the normal hours, one day's wages for more (EA s.60(3)(a)–(b), https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf). EA s.60I(1A): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded). Encoded 2026-10-07 (round 7): a daily, hourly or similar rate is paid one day's wages for up to half the normal hours and two days' for more (s.60(3)(a)); a monthly or weekly rate half a day's and a day's (s.60(3)(b)). EA First Schedule paras 1A–2: these premia bind an employee earning not more than RM4,000 a month (s.2 wages less commission, subsistence and overtime: terms.monthly_wage) or engaged in manual labour, supervising it, operating or maintaining a commercial vehicle, or as vessel crew, whatever the pay; not a domestic employee (para 2(5)); terms.overtime_by_contract applies them by contract. Fixed contractual cash allowances enter the ordinary monthly or weekly wage; travel or special-expense reimbursements belong in claims. Meal allowances receive no holiday uplift (EA s.60D(3)(b)).

description: Hours worked on a rest day, paid at the statutory rest-day multiplier.
